title: $H^2$ Stabilization of the $2$-D and $3$-D Heat Equation via Modal Decomposition
summary: Modal decomposition has been used recently to achieve boundary stabilization of linear parabolic equations in the $H^1$ norm, in two and three dimensions. In one dimension, $H^1$ exponential stability is well established and known to imply boundedness and asymptotic convergence of the state's max norm to zero. However, this implication does not necessarily hold in higher dimensions.
